``` {r Part 5}
#Convert Predictors to Factors for Models To Utilize 
prepare_raw_features <- function(data, predictor_names) {
  out <- as.data.frame(data[, ..predictor_names])
  for (nm in names(out)) {
    x <- out[[nm]]
    if (is.logical(x)) {
      out[[nm]] <- factor(ifelse(is.na(x), NA_character_,
                                 ifelse(x, "TRUE", "FALSE")))
    } else if (is.character(x)) {
      out[[nm]] <- factor(x)
    } else if (is.factor(x)) {
      out[[nm]] <- x
    } else {
      out[[nm]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
    }
  }
  out
}

#Prepare Features for Analysis in Historic & New Set
x_historic <- prepare_raw_features(historic, predictors)
x_new <- prepare_raw_features(new_properties, predictors)
y <- historic$sale_price
```

``` {r Part 6}
#Preprocess Sparse Matrix
make_design_matrices <- function(train_x, assessment_x) {
  train_x <- as.data.frame(train_x)
  assessment_x <- as.data.frame(assessment_x)
  
  #For each feature, create the train value set
  for (nm in names(train_x)) {
    if (is.numeric(train_x[[nm]])) {
      #if feature is numeric, fill values
      train_values <- train_x[[nm]][is.finite(train_x[[nm]])]
      fill_value <- if (length(train_values) == 0) {
        0
      } else {
        median(train_values)
      }

      train_x[[nm]][!is.finite(train_x[[nm]])] <- fill_value
      assessment_x[[nm]][!is.finite(assessment_x[[nm]])] <- fill_value

    } else {
      #if feature is char, train values & known levels
      train_values <- as.character(train_x[[nm]])
      assessment_values <- as.character(assessment_x[[nm]])
      train_values[is.na(train_values) | train_values == ""] <- "Missing"
      assessment_values[is.na(assessment_values) |
                          assessment_values == ""] <- "Missing"
      #Scan Over Assessed Values for Any Missings
      known_levels <- unique(c(train_values, "Missing", "Other"))
      assessment_values[!assessment_values %in% known_levels] <- "Other"
      train_x[[nm]] <- factor(train_values, levels = known_levels)
      assessment_x[[nm]] <- factor(assessment_values, levels = known_levels)
    }
  }
  combined <- rbind(train_x, assessment_x)

  #Utilize One-Hot Encoding for Factors
  full_matrix <- Matrix::sparse.model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = combined)
  n_train <- nrow(train_x)
  x_train <- full_matrix[seq_len(n_train), , drop = FALSE]
  x_assess <- full_matrix[(n_train + 1):nrow(full_matrix), , drop = FALSE]

  #Remove Any Non-Predictive Columns 
  train_means <- Matrix::colMeans(x_train)
  train_sq_means <- Matrix::colMeans(x_train ^ 2)
  train_vars <- pmax(train_sq_means - train_means ^ 2, 0)
  keep <- which(train_vars > 1e-12)

  #Create Train & train List
  list(
    x_train = x_train[, keep, drop = FALSE],
    x_assess = x_assess[, keep, drop = FALSE]
  )
}
```

``` {r Part 7}
#Build Baseline Model
baseline_predict <- function(train_data, assess_data) {
  baseline_vars <- c("char_bldg_sf", "char_hd_sf", "char_age")
  baseline_vars <- intersect(baseline_vars, names(train_data))

  if (length(baseline_vars) == 0) {
    return(rep(mean(train_data$sale_price), nrow(assess_data)))
  }
  
  #Build Baseline Train & Test Sets
  baseline_train <- as.data.frame(train_data[, ..baseline_vars])
  baseline_assess <- as.data.frame(assess_data[, ..baseline_vars])
  
  #Check that Baseline Models are Numeric
  for (nm in baseline_vars) {
    baseline_train[[nm]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(baseline_train[[nm]]))
    baseline_assess[[nm]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(baseline_assess[[nm]]))

    med <- median(baseline_train[[nm]][is.finite(baseline_train[[nm]])],
                  na.rm = TRUE)
    if (!is.finite(med)) med <- 0
    
    baseline_train[[nm]][!is.finite(baseline_train[[nm]])] <- med
    baseline_assess[[nm]][!is.finite(baseline_assess[[nm]])] <- med
  }
  
  #Setup Training Set & Run Model
  model_data <- baseline_train
  model_data$sale_price <- train_data$sale_price
  
  fit <- lm(sale_price ~ ., data = model_data)
  pred <- predict(fit, newdata = baseline_assess)
  
  #Check for Predictions are Finite
  pred[!is.finite(pred)] <- mean(train_data$sale_price)
  pmax(pred, 0)
}
```

``` {r Part 7}
#Cross-Validate MSE for Models 
set.seed(38)
fold_id <- sample(rep(seq_len(N_FOLDS), length.out = nrow(historic)))

#Setup Models
oof_baseline <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(historic))
oof_lasso <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(historic))
oof_xgb <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(historic))

#Setup Folds for K-Fold Method for Cross-Validation
for (fold in seq_len(N_FOLDS)) {
  assessment_rows <- which(fold_id == fold)
  training_rows <- which(fold_id != fold)
  fold_train <- historic[training_rows]
  fold_assess <- historic[assessment_rows]

  x_train_raw <- x_historic[training_rows, , drop = FALSE]
  x_assess_raw <- x_historic[assessment_rows, , drop = FALSE]

  #Setup OLS Linear Regresssion
  oof_baseline[assessment_rows] <- baseline_predict(
    fold_train, fold_assess
  )

  #Preprocess Per Fold for Models
  design <- make_design_matrices(x_train_raw, x_assess_raw)
  
  x_train <- design$x_train
  x_assess <- design$x_assess
  y_train <- fold_train$sale_price

  #Setup LASSO Model with 5-Fold Validation
  set.seed(29 + fold)
  lasso_fit <- cv.glmnet(
    x = x_train,
    y = y_train,
    alpha = 1,
    nfolds = 5,
    type.measure = "mse",
    standardize = TRUE,
    family = "gaussian"
  )
  
  #Setup LASSO Predictions
  lasso_pred <- as.numeric(
    predict(lasso_fit, newx = x_assess, s = "lambda.min")
  )
  lasso_pred[!is.finite(lasso_pred)] <- mean(y_train)
  oof_lasso[assessment_rows] <- pmax(lasso_pred, 0)

  #Setup XGBoost Model
  dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = x_train, label = y_train)
  dassess <- xgb.DMatrix(data = x_assess)

  xgb_params <- list(
    objective = "reg:squarederror",
    eval_metric = "rmse",
    eta = 0.04,
    max_depth = 6,
    min_child_weight = 5,
    subsample = 0.80,
    colsample_bytree = 0.80,
    lambda = 5,
    alpha = 0
  )
  
  #Setup XGBoost Predictions
  set.seed(49 + fold)
  xgb_fit <- xgb.train(
    params = xgb_params,
    data = dtrain,
    nrounds = XGB_NROUNDS,
    verbose = 0
  )
  
  xgb_pred <- as.numeric(predict(xgb_fit, dassess))
  xgb_pred[!is.finite(xgb_pred)] <- mean(y_train)
  oof_xgb[assessment_rows] <- pmax(xgb_pred, 0)
}
```

``` {r Part 8}
#Compare RMSEs for Each Model
calculate_metrics <- function(actual, predicted) {
  mse <- mean((actual - predicted)^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  rmse <- sqrt(mse)
  mae <- mean(abs(actual - predicted), na.rm = TRUE)

  c(MSE = mse, RMSE = rmse, MAE = mae)
}

#Check for Cross-Validated RMSE results
cv_results <- rbind(
  Baseline_Linear = calculate_metrics(y, oof_baseline),
  LASSO = calculate_metrics(y, oof_lasso),
  XGBoost = calculate_metrics(y, oof_xgb)
)

#Gather Cross-Validated Results
cv_results <- as.data.frame(cv_results)
cv_results$model <- rownames(cv_results)
rownames(cv_results) <- NULL
cv_results <- cv_results[, c("model", "MSE", "RMSE", "MAE")]
cv_results <- cv_results[order(cv_results$MSE), ]

#Print Best Model Based on CV MSE
cat("\nCross-Validated Model Performance (Dollars):\n")
print(cv_results, row.names = FALSE)
fwrite(cv_results, file.path(DATA_DIR, "model_cv_results.csv"))
best_model <- cv_results$model[1]
message("\nBest Model on Cross-Validated MSE >>> ", best_model)
```

``` {r Part 9}
#Refit Model with Historical Observations
final_design <- make_design_matrices(x_historic, x_new)
x_full <- final_design$x_train
x_prediction <- final_design$x_assess

#Check which Model is the Best
if (best_model == "Baseline_Linear") {
  final_predictions <- baseline_predict(historic, new_properties)

} else if (best_model == "LASSO") { #if best model is lasso, then create final LASSO model
  set.seed(39)
  final_lasso <- cv.glmnet(
    x = x_full,
    y = y,
    alpha = 1,
    nfolds = 5,
    type.measure = "mse",
    standardize = TRUE,
    family = "gaussian"
  )
  
  #Create Final Predictions from Historic LASSO Model
  final_predictions <- as.numeric(
    predict(final_lasso, newx = x_prediction, s = "lambda.min")
  )

} else { #if best model is xgboost, then create final XGBoost model
  dtrain_full <- xgb.DMatrix(data = x_full, label = y)
  dpredict <- xgb.DMatrix(data = x_prediction)

  final_xgb <- xgb.train(
    params = xgb_params,
    data = dtrain_full,
    nrounds = XGB_NROUNDS,
    verbose = 0
  )

  #Create Final Predictions from Historic XGBoost Model
  final_predictions <- as.numeric(predict(final_xgb, dpredict))
}

fallback_value <- median(y, na.rm = TRUE)
final_predictions[!is.finite(final_predictions)] <- fallback_value
final_predictions <- pmax(final_predictions, 0)
```

``` {r Part 11}
#Create the Diagnostic Figure for Presentation
plot_data <- data.frame(
  Model = factor(
    cv_results$model,
    levels = cv_results$model
  ),
  RMSE = cv_results$RMSE
)

#Create Performance Plot File
performance_plot <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Model, y = RMSE)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0("$", format(round(RMSE), big.mark = ","))),
    vjust = -0.35,
    size = 4
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste0(
      "Cross-Validated RMSE"
    ),
    subtitle = "Five-Fold Comparison",
    x = "Model",
    y = "RMSE (USD)"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = function(x) paste0("$", format(x, big.mark = ",")),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 15, hjust = 1)
  )

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(DATA_DIR, "model_diagnostics.png"),
  plot = performance_plot,
  width = 9,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```

## Incremental Models
```{r}
library(dplyr)
```

First, let's remove categoricals that have more than 5 levels, since they will harm interpretability
```{r}
xh_copy <- copy(x_historic)
xn_copy <- copy(x_new)

for (col in names(xh_copy)){
  
  if ((n_distinct(xh_copy[col]) > 5) & (is.factor(xh_copy[[col]]) | is.character(xh_copy[[col]]))){
    xh_copy = xh_copy[,-which(col == names(xh_copy))]
    xn_copy = xn_copy[,-which(col == names(xn_copy))]
  }
}
xh_copy <- select(xh_copy,-c("meta_town_code","meta_nbhd"), -starts_with("geo"))
xn_copy <- select(xn_copy,-c("meta_town_code","meta_nbhd"), -starts_with("geo"))
str(xh_copy)
```
